title: Conditional κ = 0.00302725 (+5.75235e-7 over #5387): owned circuit transposition
body:
This construction gives **conditional κ = 12109/4000000 = 0.00302725**. It improves the selected value 0.0030217758 by **0.0000054742**, and exceeds the later [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387) compiler refinement by **0.000000575235**. The paid circuit changes: the two forward calls now use the reduced backward supplier. This adds 12.5% to the complete moment gain of the eight-relation source.

The [proof and complete bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/README.md), [result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/RESULT.json), [emitted word](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/WORD.json.gz), [phase recipes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/PHASES.json.gz) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/SOURCES.json) define the review object. The branch starts at canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority revision 7.

The construction applies classical linear transposition to a complete circuit with owned storage. Reverse the instruction order and transpose each primitive; an owned COPY becomes ADD then CLEAR. For the source normalized interfaces, `F = J B^T J`, where `J = diag(Q^2, -I)`. The Q-squared maps and helper corrections are native translations. The minus sign is scalar on the full field, outside the tensor power. All 17 owned fields return zero. The source zero-row markers become physical identity; the argument does not assume that the reverse rows are zero.

This consumes the [published eight-relation construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/README.md) from [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383), fixed at `4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e`, and the native tensor theorem and separate checker from [PR #5369](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5369), fixed at `18354f41de4dc7bfda4692e814cf1d91a6d619ef`. Their exact source files are retained in this branch's ancestor `5eb314069417db1f4305430b6b14f20e9251e509`. A clean checkout needs no separately fetched pending PR. The source relation discovery is credited to [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383); the new contribution transfers its completed saving to the forward interface.

Relative to [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383), the complete bill removes **16 H1 and 16 H8 paid calls**, and debits **16 H9 productive targets**. Both directions have paid profile `{1:2193, 2:412, 3:510, 4:127, 5:40}` and helper profile `{4:28, 7:7, 8:47, 9:318}`. All 18 full calls, 15 query shears, main targets and idle jobs give **64,116 paid calls and 10,784 productive fields**, with rank surplus 752. All added scalar operations, 224 main translations and 400 helper translations are charged. The complete raw nonrecursive allowance is 361,098,496 < 10^9.

Two rational interval engines put the fixed-profile crossing in **(0.00302728824993, 0.00302728824994)**. The claimed bound leaves more than 0.00000003824993 raw headroom. Tested saving 0.00302726, reserve 10^-9, both completion tails, the finite compiler and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates pass. The compiler threshold is `N = 2^31385200000000`; the expanded word is not materialized.

With CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-transpose-owned
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/native-transpose-owned
```

Each registered mathematical replay must print:

```text
PASS_CONDITIONAL_KAPPA_00302725_OWNED_TRANSPOSE
```

Normal and optimized registered replays pass on CPython 3.12.14. They check all 641 entry fields, arbitrary frame-boundary cancellation, the complete native identity certificate and its separate checker, all 2,847 paid phase classes, 180 native warp classes on 92,160 literal columns, the complete controller and the full bound. Negative controls reject wrong transposition, missing cleanup, wrong relation, wrong absolute phase, scalar/tensor sign confusion, unearned helper credit and invalid outer parameters. All 32 committed-file bindings, seven exact copied-source checks and official export integrity pass. An optimized read-only replay with Git unavailable also passes; all 33 exported files remain unchanged. Hosted CI is separate and is not claimed here.

The result retains the [five selected framework assumptions](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr4610/PROOF-REVIEW.md). Physical tape and numerical precision execution, ordinary BIT native replay, analytic decomposition, prime avoidance and integer recovery are reused contracts, not fresh checks. No Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. This is an author-checked conditional construction; the selected frontier is unchanged.

Credit: Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Our [PR #5377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5377) and [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383) supply the owned relation construction and pricing lineage. [PR #5369's proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18354f41de4dc7bfda4692e814cf1d91a6d619ef/research/native-tensor-cutoff/PROOF.md) supplies the native identity criterion. Cao Yifan (@intqwq) supplies the final native word in [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610); Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) supplies the controller lineage in [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). The [source notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac/research/native-transpose-owned/source/NOTICE.md) links the exact sources and retains @Dugongue, @zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the earlier native/compiler contributors. Classical transposition is not claimed as new. [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387) is related compiler work, not a consumed dependency.

The [canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154367) records coordination. This is one isolated package. The reusable next step is to transpose a stronger completed backward supplier after checking its normalized interface, owned inputs and full bill.
